h1b: We make it ring to you.
tagline: A boutique-fitness member is worth $1,500–$3,000 a year — and the studio's whole growth problem is turning a curious first-timer into a standing class booking. We turn Spin Machine into a 10-line Smart-DID grid where every trial, membership, and class inquiry is answered instantly, booked, and followed up until they clip in.
demoNote: Indoor cycling studio campaign · free trial · membership · class packs · corporate · 10-line pack
insight: an indoor-cycling member pays $1,500–$3,000 a year and stays for years once hooked — but the first-timer decides on impulse, usually after a friend or an ad, and books whoever answers with a friendly voice. A rung-out phone during a class loses that member. A phone number that just rings can't answer mid-ride. A Smart DID can.

pillars.p: A compliant dialer works trial no-shows and lapsed riders — branded caller-ID, friendly scripting, recordings, callbacks. You convert the curious and win back the drifted.
10 tracked lines + 24/7 answer + SMS. Every source measured, every inquiry routed, every missed call auto-called-back.
Calls, texts, trials booked, ad spend and source — one live dashboard. You finally see which ad filled which bike.

commandCenter.note: Every call feeds a real-time conduit your customized "second brain" analyzes on the fly — then you, or the AI, adjust the leads, script, offer, class, or channel and watch the ride fill. You lead the class — we make the phone ring.
